tools.description: Adds your company to the Shellui hosting waitlist and returns the access row with status pending. Staff approve or deny it separately.
tools.name: hosting_create_access_request

tools.description: Creates a Shellui Actions webhook rule from name, event_type, and url, and returns the rule metadata. The plaintext signing secret is omitted.

allow_private_urls.description: Staff only. Allow a private or loopback webhook URL.

authorization_header.description: Optional Authorization header value sent with the webhook.

description.description: Optional note about what this rule is for.

enabled.description: When false, the rule does not send webhooks.

event_type.description: Shellui Actions event id this rule subscribes to.

name.description: Rule name shown in the Shellui Actions list.

secret.description: Optional signing secret. Omit it and Shellui generates one.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the signed webhook.

tools.name: hosting_create_action_rules

tools.description: Registers a hosted site from name (the slug) and optional display_name, and returns the new app. Upload and finalize a deployment in later calls.

name.description: Unique slug under the company (lowercase, hyphens).

tools.name: hosting_create_apps

tools.description: Opens a draft deployment for app_ref from app_version and shellui_version, and returns the draft deployment id used for upload and finalize.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

app_version.description: Semver of your app build (for example `1.2.3`).

pinned.description: When true, rollback skips this deployment unless explicitly selected.

shellui_version.description: Shellui framework version bundled in the artifact.

tools.name: hosting_create_apps_deployments

tools.description: Confirms the artifact for deployment_id on app_ref is in storage, records its size, and returns the deployment with status uploading.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

deployment_id.description: Deployment UUID from list or create responses.

tools.name: hosting_create_apps_deployments_artifact_upload_complete

tools.description: Returns a time-limited PUT URL and headers so you can upload the .tar.gz for deployment_id on app_ref outside this tool. Optional expires_in is how many seconds the URL stays valid.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

deployment_id.description: Deployment UUID from list or create responses.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the upload URL expires (60 to server default).

tools.name: hosting_create_apps_deployments_artifact_upload_url

tools.description: Activates deployment_id on app_ref so the site serves that artifact, and returns the deployment. Preview sites reset the 7-day expiry timer on success.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

deployment_id.description: Deployment UUID from list or create responses.

tools.name: hosting_create_apps_deployments_finalize

tools.description: Serves the older deployment_id on app_ref again and returns that deployment as active. Artifact files stay in storage.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

deployment_id.description: Deployment UUID from list or create responses.

tools.name: hosting_create_apps_deployments_rollback

tools.description: Registers hostname on app_ref and returns DNS TXT instructions plus a verification token. This does not verify DNS or issue TLS.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

hostname.description: Fully qualified hostname (not under the default app hosting domain).

tools.name: hosting_create_apps_domains

tools.description: Refreshes custom hostname domain_id on app_ref, moves pending_dns to awaiting_platform, and returns the updated hostname. verified and serving stay false.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

domain_id.description: Custom domain UUID from list or create responses.

tools.name: hosting_create_apps_domains_refresh

tools.description: Creates or replaces an environment variable on app_ref from key and value, and returns key plus value_present. The value is encrypted and is not echoed.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

value.description: New value. Never echoed in list or get responses.

tools.name: hosting_create_apps_environment

tools.description: Extends preview site app_ref by 7 days and returns the updated app. Production sites ignore this call.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

tools.name: hosting_create_apps_renew_expiry

tools.description: Creates or refreshes a preview site from app_version and shellui_version (optional slug) and returns the app, a draft deployment, and public URLs. Preview sites expire 7 days after the last successful finalize or renew-expiry call.

display_name.description: Optional label for the preview site.

shellui_version.description: Shellui framework version in the bundle.

slug.description: Optional preview slug. Omit to allocate a new slug.

tools.name: hosting_create_preview

tools.description: Deletes Shellui Actions webhook rule id and returns an empty result. In-flight deliveries may still finish.
tools.name: hosting_delete_action_rules

tools.description: Deletes the hosted site app_ref, including deployments and stored artifacts, and returns an empty result. This cannot be undone.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

tools.name: hosting_delete_apps

tools.description: Removes custom hostname domain_id from app_ref and returns an empty result. This cannot be undone.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

domain_id.description: Custom domain UUID from list or create responses.

tools.name: hosting_delete_apps_domains

tools.description: Deletes environment variable key from app_ref and returns an empty result. This cannot be undone.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

tools.name: hosting_delete_apps_environment

tools.description: Reads Shellui Actions webhook delivery delivery_id and returns attempts, HTTP statuses, and the signed envelope.
tools.name: hosting_get_action_deliveries

tools.description: Reads domain event log row id and returns the full event payload for that row.
tools.name: hosting_get_action_event_log

tools.description: Returns how many days Shellui keeps company domain events, the oldest event time, and whether older rows suggest the purge job is behind.
tools.name: hosting_get_action_event_log_retention

tools.description: Reads Shellui Actions webhook rule id and returns its metadata with a masked secret hint. The plaintext secret is omitted.
tools.name: hosting_get_action_rules

tools.description: Reads the hosted site app_ref (slug or UUID) and returns its metadata, including preview expires_at when set.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

tools.name: hosting_get_apps

tools.description: Reads custom hostname domain_id on app_ref and returns hostname, DNS instructions, and status.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

domain_id.description: Custom domain UUID from list or create responses.

tools.name: hosting_get_apps_domains

tools.description: Reads environment variable key on app_ref and returns key, value_present, and updated_at. The stored value is not included.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

tools.name: hosting_get_apps_environment

tools.description: Lists deploy token metadata for your company and returns prefix, expiry, and last used time. Plaintext secrets are never included.
tools.name: hosting_get_deploy_tokens

tools.description: Returns aggregate app and deployment counts for your company.
tools.name: hosting_get_stats

tools.description: Lists recent Shellui Actions webhook deliveries and returns status, attempt counts, and errors. Optional status filters to pending, delivered, failed, or dead.

action_rule_id.description: Shellui Actions webhook rule id to match.

created_after.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Include deliveries created at or after this time.

created_before.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Include deliveries created at or before this time.

page_size.description: Page size. The server caps this at 100.

tools.name: hosting_list_action_deliveries

tools.description: Lists recent domain events for your company and returns the matching rows. Optional event_type filters to one catalog event id.

event_type.description: One catalog event id to match.

page_size.description: Page size. The server caps this at 100.

user.description: Case-insensitive substring of the actor email.

tools.name: hosting_list_action_event_log

tools.description: Lists domain event type ids you can use in event log filters and Shellui Actions rules, and returns each type, label, and description.
tools.name: hosting_list_action_event_log_types

tools.description: Lists Shellui Actions event types you can subscribe to and returns each event id, label, and payload field docs.
tools.name: hosting_list_action_events

tools.description: Lists Shellui Actions webhook rules for your company and returns rule metadata. Signing secrets are omitted.
tools.name: hosting_list_action_rules

tools.description: Lists every hosted site for your company and returns each app id, slug, display name, current deployment, and preview expiry when set.
tools.name: hosting_list_apps

tools.description: Lists deployments for site app_ref, newest first, and returns each deployment status and artifact metadata.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

tools.name: hosting_list_apps_deployments

tools.description: Lists custom hostnames on app_ref and returns hostname, DNS instructions, and status. verified and serving stay false until the platform confirms DNS.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

tools.name: hosting_list_apps_domains

tools.description: Lists environment variable names on app_ref and returns key, value_present, and updated_at. Values are never included.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

tools.name: hosting_list_apps_environment

tools.description: Lists recent HTTP requests for app_ref and returns status code, request path, and HTTP method for each row. Optional limit, cursor, status_min, and status_max page and filter the list.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response (`next_cursor`).

limit.description: Page size (default 50, capped by the server).

status_max.description: Include responses with status_code less than or equal to this value.

status_min.description: Include responses with status_code greater than or equal to this value.

tools.name: hosting_list_apps_request_logs

tools.description: Reads runtime logs for app_ref (optional limit) and returns source none, an unavailable_reason, and an empty lines list because static hosting has no process output.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

limit.description: Max lines to return (capped by the server).

tools.name: hosting_list_apps_runtime_logs

tools.description: Replaces the value of environment variable key on app_ref and returns key plus value_present. The previous value cannot be read back.

app_ref.description: Site slug (for example `my-app`) or app UUID.

value.description: New value. Never echoed in list or get responses.

token_id.description: Deploy token UUID from list or create responses.

tools.name: hosting_revoke_deploy_token

tools.name: hosting_send_test_rule

authorization_header.description: Optional Authorization header value sent with the webhook.

description.description: Optional note about what this rule is for.

enabled.description: When false, the rule does not send webhooks.

event_type.description: Shellui Actions event id this rule subscribes to.
